ambient-ai.title: Ambient AI: Voice-to-Note Documentation For Care Teams
ambient-ai.description: Record clinical visits and generate compliant notes automatically, synced straight to your EHR — built for every care setting.
ambient-ai.heroSub: Murphi.ai Ambient AI records clinical visits and generates compliant notes automatically — synced to your EHR. 70% less documentation time. 98.7% accuracy.

sections.heading: From Voice to EHR in Four Steps
sections.lead: Clinicians record their visit naturally. Murphi.ai does the rest — generating a structured, compliant clinical note and syncing it to your EHR automatically.

steps.title: Record
steps.description: Clinician speaks naturally during or after the visit. No scripting, no keywords, no special phrases required.

steps.title: Transcribe
steps.description: Murphi.ai transcribes with 98.7% accuracy across 55 languages. Medication names, clinical terms, and diagnoses recognized automatically.

steps.title: Generate
steps.description: AI generates a structured clinical note in the correct format — OASIS, SOAP, PIE, BIRP, DAP, IDG, or your specialty template.

steps.title: Sync
steps.description: Note is reviewed, approved, and synced directly to your EHR. No copy-paste. No rekeying. Documentation complete.

h1Lines: AI-Powered Payer Contract Review & Reimbursement Optimization
contract-analyzer.heroSub: Murphi.ai surfaces underpayments, flags non-compliant clauses, and generates operating manuals from payer contracts. PADU Plus methodology.

sections.heading: A Systematic Approach to Payer Contract Optimization
sections.lead: PADU Plus is Murphi.ai's proprietary methodology for payer contract analysis — moving beyond rate comparison to surface systemic underpayments, compliance gaps, and operational misalignments.

features.title: Contract Analysis
features.description: AI reads and analyzes payer contracts — fee schedules, coverage policies, billing rules, timely filing requirements, and reimbursement methodologies. Every clause reviewed, every rate captured.

features.title: Operating Manual Generation
features.description: AI generates plain-language operating manuals from contract language — translating complex payer terms into actionable workflows for billing, coding, and clinical staff.

features.title: Contract vs. Manual Gap Analysis
features.description: AI compares what the contract says against how your organization actually operates — surfacing compliance gaps, billing errors, and process misalignments before they become denials or audits.

features.title: Reimbursement Leakage Detection
features.description: AI identifies systematic underpayments — claims paid at incorrect rates, missing carve-outs, and overlooked contract provisions. Surfaces underpayment patterns across your payer mix.

features.title: Non-Compliant Clause Flagging
features.description: AI flags contract clauses that conflict with CMS guidelines, state regulations, or your organization's billing practices — before contract execution or renewal.

features.title: Payer Mix Optimization
features.description: AI analyzes reimbursement rates across your full payer mix — identifying which payers, service lines, and contract structures are performing below benchmark.
